               <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rnog lo</rs> chenos | rgyus 'bras mtshon gyi don du bsrungs na <lb n="6a7"/> yang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db">slob dpon seng bzangs</rs> kyis ni yul ying dun mtshon pi don nyid yin par 'gre+en gyi skabs dang po rdzogs ma tham tu gsal bar sungs pas | slob dpon gyi dgongs pa ni rus 'bras mtshan se kyi don du mi bcung | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog lo</rs> chen pos rgyus 'bras mtshon gyi don du gsungs pa 'phang pi bzhes mdzad snang bas de mtha' <lb n="6a8"/> tu 'gal bar mi bzung ngo o || </seg></TEI>
